fx_annual_drift_vs_usd.source: Pegged currency; no expected USD erosion

annual_growth.source: GASTAT 2024 growth 4.7% total, mostly non-Saudis; nationals grow ~1.5%/yr

population.base_note: Hemoglobinopathy burden is concentrated in Saudi nationals (Eastern Province, Jazan, Madinah). Expatriate carriers exist but are rarely reimbursed by the state; excluded.

oop_share_of_health_exp.source: Our World in Data / WHO GHED: 14.1% OOP 2023

pharma_market_usd.source: Market reports put Saudi pharma sales near SAR 40bn (~USD 10.7bn) in 2024; used only for the budget-impact ceiling

health_system.summary: Government-dominated. MoH hospitals (procured centrally through NUPCO), other government providers (KFSH&RC, National Guard, Ministry of Defense, university hospitals) with their own budgets, and a private sector funded by mandatory CHI health insurance for expatriates and private-sector employees. Hereditary blood disease centres sit in the Eastern Province (Qatif, Al-Ahsa, Dammam), Jazan, Madinah, Jeddah and Riyadh.
sources: PharmaBoardroom, Market Access & HTA: Saudi Arabia, https://pharmaboardroom.com/legal-reports/market-access-health-technology-assesment-saudi-arabia/

regulatory.pathway: Abridged/verification review for FDA- or EMA-approved products; Breakthrough Medicines Program for priority assets

typical_review_months.source: SFDA abridged review target; Pyrukynd was filed 2024 and approved 2025-08-04 under the Breakthrough Medicines Program

p_approval_given_fda_ema.source: Reliance pathway; approval risk is low once FDA/EMA approve

pricing.authority: SFDA Drug Pricing (2023 Drug Pricing Guidelines)

months_to_price_after_approval.source: SFDA prices at registration; public price list published on sfda.gov.sa

reprice_cut.source: SFDA may review price 2 years after registration; repricing capped at 30% cut (Biomapas summary of 2021 guideline)

pricing.notes: Basket size has moved 30 -> 20 (2021) -> 16 (2022) per ISPOR 2023 poster; one 2024 source cites 34. The statistic (median vs lowest) is not fixed in public text: 'SFDA did not state that they will strictly select the lowest price'. Median of available basket prices, capped at the country-of-origin price, is used as the base case; 'min' is run in sensitivity.
sources: ISPOR Europe 2023, External Reference Pricing Policy of Pharmaceutical Products in Saudi Arabia, https://www.ispor.org/heor-resources/presentations-database/presentation-paper/euro2023-3764/17195/
Biomapas, Saudi FDA's New Pricing Guidelines, https://biomapas.com/saudi-fdas-new-pricing-guidelines-and-impact-on-the-region
Eversana, Saudi Arabia Rolls Out New Pricing Guidelines, https://www.eversana.com/?p=17996

payers.name: MoH hospitals via NUPCO central procurement
payers.note: National procurement agreement is the gate Agios itself named ('over the next couple of years', Q3 2025). Tender discount vs SFDA list assumed 20%.

payers.name: Other government providers (KFSH&RC, NGHA, MODA, university hospitals)
payers.note: Institution-level formulary decisions; faster than NUPCO; these centres ran the ENERGIZE trials

payers.name: Private sector, CHI-insured (Unified Drug Formulary)
payers.note: Mostly expatriates and private-sector Saudis; insurers restrict high-cost orphan drugs

early_access_share.source: Calibrated to Agios' reported rest-of-world revenue: $1.9m in Q1 2026 (before the EU approval, so almost all GCC early access via NewBridge) rising to $3.8m (Q2) and $6.6m (Q3, EU included). At a ~$150k transfer price that is roughly 30-45 Saudi patients on therapy during 2026, i.e. ~1.2% of the eligible pool treated case-by-case from hospital budgets.
early_access_share.note: Share of label-eligible patients treated through early access (named-patient / hospital budget) before any payer listing; paid at list price.

budget_ceiling_share_of_pharma_market.source: A single orphan product above ~1% of national drug spend triggers price-volume negotiation; modelled as a soft cap on public net price

disease_prevalence_per_1000_adults.source: National premarital screening 2011-2015, n=1,230,582: beta-thalassemia 13.6/1000 (12.9 trait, 0.7 disease); JEGH 2019 https://doaj.org/article/efa04d78045743e4831a5bf995ebcd2d ; regional 134/1000 hemoglobinopathy in Eastern Province (Memish 2011, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21623050/)
disease_prevalence_per_1000_adults.note: Screened population is marriage-age adults, so this is an adult prevalence of beta-thalassemia disease (major + intermedia). Low case assumes some 'disease' calls are mild intermedia never seen in care.

alpha_thal_hbh_multiplier.source: HbH disease is common in the Eastern Province (Thrombosis J 2023, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12959-023-00560-w); label covers alpha-thalassemia; adds ~12% to the pool

diagnosed_share.source: Mandatory premarital screening since 2004 plus dedicated hereditary blood disease centres

in_specialist_care_share.source: Single-centre cohorts (Al-Ahsa 158 TDT, Jeddah 152 TDT, Madinah 111 TDT) imply most TDT are followed; many NTDT are not

label_eligible_share.source: Adults with TDT, or NTDT with Hb <=10 g/dL (ENERGIZE entry criteria); excludes post-HSCT / gene therapy

tdt_share_of_eligible.source: Centre cohorts are TDT-heavy; national pool is NTDT-heavy

soc_annual_cost_usd.source: Transfusion + chelation + monitoring; Saudi TDT cost-of-illness study (Medicine 2025, PMC12237305) exists but was not readable from this session

in_specialist_care_share.source: Large SCD population; milder Arab-Indian haplotype in Eastern Province

label_eligible_share.source: Adults with symptomatic anemia; pending label

competition_weights.note: Payer/clinician utility weights for the share model. Price weight lower than Colombia: government payer, high WTP for hereditary disease

commercial.perspective_note: Launch-partner P&L (NewBridge-type): revenue is in-market net sales; a transfer price is paid to the originator.

upfront_costs_usd.label: Pricing / market-access dossiers, NUPCO and institutional listings

launch_opex_usd_per_year.source: 3-4 FTE (medical, KAM, access), congresses, patient support, PV

transfer_price_share_of_net.source: Typical in-licence / distribution economics for an originator-supplied orphan product; set to the MOU terms when known

persistence_annual.source: Agios Q3 2026: 75% persistency at 6 months in US launch; annualised on-therapy factor
